name: agent-flow
description: A pane (/agent-flow) with the main agent and every subagent: status, model, tokens, tool calls, what each is doing now with slow/thinking/silent signs, [+] details, unlisted loops, main_Diff / sub_Diff; /agent-flow stats sums the logged runs by agent and model

slowSeconds.title: Slow tool call (seconds)
slowSeconds.description: Mark a running tool call ⚠ slow past this (red past 3×); tools that wait by design (Agent, Monitor, ...) are never slow

slowShellSeconds.title: Slow shell call (seconds)
slowShellSeconds.description: The same for Bash / PowerShell, whose builds and tests run long

silentSeconds.title: Silent agent (seconds)
silentSeconds.description: Mark a working agent ⚠ silent when it has had no tool call and no model request under way for this long (red past 3×)

log.title: Log subagent runs
log.description: Keep one line per finished subagent run (type, model, tokens, time, calls, edits) across sessions for /agent-flow stats
